instruction: Configure VLC to disable 'one instance when started from file' mode, so that multiple instances can run simultaneously.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling 'one instance when started from file' in VLC preferences (Tools > Preferences > Interface > Playlist and Instances). The evaluator checks VLC config file for one-instance-when-started-from-file=0. Uses existing check_one_instance_when_started_from_file metric from vlc.py.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correct: get_vlc_config extracts VLC config file (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc) to cache
Metric logic correct: check_one_instance_when_started_from_file reads config file and checks for 'one-instance-when-started-from-file=0'
Parameter handling correct: Metric function directly accesses rule dictionary keys (rule['expected_one_instance_when_started_from_file']), correctly handling expected.type='rule'
Complete coverage: Instruction requires disabling one-instance mode, evaluator checks exactly this setting
Expected value correct: '0' means disabled, matching instruction requirement
State accessibility verified: VLC config file is persisted to disk, no UI/dialog dependency, no postconfig needed
